caption:
Humility: you cannot outgrow the mountains

Allah tells us not to walk on the earth arrogantly, for we can neither cleave the earth nor reach the mountains in height. Whatever you achieve today, carry it with humility.

Surah Al-Israa 17:37

Send this to someone whose humility you admire

#humility #stayshumble #surahisra #quranreels

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
